meta.price_basis: Atomic bid/ask midpoint, selected at each one-minute receiver time; not trade OHLC.
meta.bar_definition: First completed bar includes the session-open snapshot; later bars use (previous close,current close].
meta.vwap_definition: Observed session tape VWAP reconstructed as received midpoint minus saved vwap_distance_ticks times tick size.
meta.flow_definition: (Buy-initiated classified volume minus sell-initiated classified volume) / total aggressor-classified volume across the preceding five receiver-minute bins. Available only when at least 80% of total volume is classified, classified volume is positive, and contributing bins contain no trade delayed more than 30 seconds. Not an institutional position or absorption estimate.
meta.event_definition: Opening range known only at +30m; strict close break, held on the second successive close outside; returned_inside requires a completed close inside the range.
meta.forecast_definition: Frozen model endpoint-class probabilities with an origin-specific neutral band; three horizons fitted separately; no future realized outcomes included.
meta.replay_rule: Display only bars/events/forecasts with time at or before the replay cursor; level only at or after known_at_time.

opening_range.definition: Received valid one-minute midpoint snapshots from session open through +30m, endpoints included.
